info.title: Opereit Invoice Auditing API
info.description: Public API for the Opereit Invoice Auditing product. Upload carrier contracts, run audits against incoming carrier invoices, and retrieve line items and findings.

post.description:
Upload a carrier contract document. Opereit asynchronously extracts rate cards and surcharges from the file. The contract is created with `status=PROCESSING`; it transitions to `ACTIVE` once extraction completes (or `FAILED` if extraction errors out).

Accepted file formats: PDF, PNG, JPEG, CSV, XLS, XLSX.

file.description: The contract document. Accepted MIME types: `application/pdf`, `image/png`, `image/jpeg`, `text/csv`, `application/vnd.ms-excel`, `application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet`.

carrier_name.description: The carrier this contract belongs to (e.g. `UPS`, `FedEx`, `DHL Express`).

signing_date.description: Date the contract was signed, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

account_number.description: Optional carrier account number this contract applies to.

get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated list of contracts uploaded by your organization.

parameters.name: carrier_name
parameters.description: Filter by carrier name (case-insensitive exact match).

get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated list of rate-card entries extracted from a contract. Each entry represents a single (origin, destination, service, weight) rate.

parameters.name: origin_country
parameters.description: Filter by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 origin country code.

parameters.name: destination_country
parameters.description: Filter by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 destination country code.

parameters.name: weight_min
parameters.description: Return only rates whose weight band overlaps with weight ≥ this value (kg).

parameters.name: weight_max
parameters.description: Return only rates whose weight band overlaps with weight ≤ this value (kg).

get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated list of surcharges extracted from a contract (fuel, residential delivery, peak-season, etc.).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text search against the surcharge display name.

parameters.name: billing_type
parameters.description: Filter by how the surcharge is billed.

parameters.name: service_type
parameters.description: Filter by carrier service code the surcharge applies to.

parameters.name: is_waived
parameters.description: If `true`, returns only surcharges marked as waived in the contract.

post.description:
Upload a carrier invoice and audit it against the rates and surcharges of an existing contract. Returns immediately with `status=PENDING`; auditing runs asynchronously. Poll `GET /v1/invoice-audits` until `status=COMPLETE` to retrieve findings.

Accepted file formats: PDF, CSV.

file.description: The carrier invoice document. Accepted MIME types: `application/pdf`, `text/csv`.

contract_id.description: ID of the contract to audit this invoice against.

get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated list of invoice audits.

parameters.name: contract_id
parameters.description: Filter by the contract used for the audit.

get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated list of line items (individual shipment charges) extracted from the invoice. Each line item is a single charge — a rate, surcharge, or adjustment — applied to one tracking number.

parameters.name: charge_type
parameters.description: Filter by the kind of charge.

parameters.name: tracking_number
parameters.description: Return only line items associated with this tracking number.

parameters.name: has_finding
parameters.description: If `true`, return only line items that have at least one finding.

get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated list of findings — discrepancies detected between the carrier invoice and the contract. See `AuditFinding.type` for the catalog of finding types.

parameters.name: tracking_number
parameters.description: Return only findings tied to this tracking number.

parameters.name: excluded
parameters.description: If `false`, return only active (non-excluded) findings. If `true`, return only excluded findings. Omit to return both.

apiKey.description: HTTP Basic Auth using your API key. Send `Authorization: Basic base64(key_id:key_secret)`.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Number of items to return per request.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response. Omit on the first request.

BadRequest.description: The request was malformed or failed validation.

NotFound.description: The requested resource does not exist.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor to use in the next request to fetch the next page. `null` if there are no more items.

has_more.description: Whether there are more items to fetch beyond the current page.

Contract.description: A carrier contract uploaded to Opereit. Rates and surcharges are extracted asynchronously.

account_number.description: Carrier account number this contract applies to, if any.

effective_date.description: Date the contracted rates take effect, if specified.

expiration_date.description: Date the contract expires, if specified.

status.description:
Contract lifecycle state.

- `PROCESSING`: extraction in progress.
- `ACTIVE`: extraction complete; rates and surcharges are available.
- `EXPIRED`: contract expiration date has passed.
- `FAILED`: extraction failed; see `status_reason`.

file_url.description: Time-limited URL to download the original contract file.

rate_count.description: Number of rate-card entries extracted from the contract.

surcharge_count.description: Number of surcharges extracted from the contract.

ContractRate.description: A single rate-card entry extracted from a contract: the price for shipping a parcel matching the (origin, destination, service, weight) selectors.

origin_postcode.description: Origin postcode pattern, if the rate is postcode-specific.

destination_postcode.description: Destination postcode pattern, if the rate is postcode-specific.

service_type.description: Carrier service code this rate applies to.

container_type.description: Container or packaging the rate applies to.

weight.description: Exact weight in kg this rate applies to (only set when `weight_mode=FIXED`).

weight_min.description: Lower bound of the weight band in kg, inclusive (only set when `weight_mode=RANGE`).

weight_max.description: Upper bound of the weight band in kg, exclusive (only set when `weight_mode=RANGE`).

weight_mode.description: Whether the rate applies to an exact weight or a weight band.

rate_type.description: Whether `rate` is a flat fee per shipment or a per-kilogram price.

rate.description: Decimal price as a string (preserves precision).

ContractSurcharge.description: A surcharge extracted from a contract — an additional fee applied to shipments under specific conditions.

slug.description: Stable identifier for the surcharge type.

origin_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 origin country code, if the surcharge is geographically scoped.

destination_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 destination country code, if the surcharge is geographically scoped.

service_type.description: Service code this surcharge applies to, or `null` if it applies to all services.

billing_type.description:
How the surcharge is billed.

- `PERCENTAGE`: % of one or more line items (see `calculation_base`).
- `PERCENTAGE_OF_BASE`: % of the base shipping rate only.
- `FIXED`: flat fee per shipment.
- `TIERED`: amount varies by weight or other tier.
- `PERCENTAGE_OFF`: discount, expressed as a percentage.

value.description: Surcharge value as a decimal string. Interpretation depends on `billing_type` (e.g. `"15.00"` = 15% for `PERCENTAGE`, or 15 currency units for `FIXED`).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (relevant for `FIXED` and `TIERED` surcharges).

is_waived.description: Whether this surcharge is waived under the contract.

calculation_base.description: For `PERCENTAGE` surcharges, the list of slugs the percentage is applied to (e.g. `["base_rate"]`).

InvoiceAuditFile.description: Metadata about the invoice document uploaded for an audit.

file_url.description: Time-limited URL to download the original invoice file.

original_file_name.description: Filename as uploaded by the client.

invoice_number.description: Carrier invoice number, extracted from the document.

invoice_date.description: Date on the invoice, extracted from the document.

account_number.description: Carrier account number on the invoice.

billing_period_start.description: Start of the billing period covered by the invoice.

billing_period_end.description: End of the billing period covered by the invoice.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code the invoice is denominated in.

InvoiceAudit.description: An audit of a carrier invoice against a contract.

contract_id.description: Contract this invoice was audited against.

carrier_name.description: Carrier name (denormalized from the contract for convenience).

status.description:
Audit lifecycle state.

- `PENDING`: queued for processing.
- `INGESTING`: parsing the invoice file.
- `AUDITING`: running audit rules.
- `COMPLETE`: line items and findings are available.
- `FAILED`: audit failed; see `status_reason`.

total_line_items.description: Total line items extracted from the invoice. `null` until ingestion completes.

completed_at.description: When the audit reached a terminal state (`COMPLETE` or `FAILED`).

file.description: Metadata about the uploaded invoice file.

InvoiceLineItem.description: A single charge from the carrier invoice — a rate, surcharge, or adjustment applied to one tracking number.

tracking_number.description: Carrier tracking number for the shipment.

charge_description.description: Free-text charge description from the invoice (e.g. `"Fuel surcharge"`).

charge_type.description:
Kind of charge.

- `RATE`: base shipping rate.
- `SURCHARGE`: add-on fee.
- `ADJUSTMENT`: correction or credit.

service_type.description: Carrier service code applied to the shipment.

amount.description: Amount billed, as a decimal string.

weight.description: Actual weight in kg, as a decimal string.

billed_weight.description: Billed (chargeable) weight in kg, as a decimal string. May differ from `weight` due to dimensional weight.

container_type.description: Container or packaging for the shipment.

zone.description: Carrier zone applied to the shipment, if any.

has_finding.description: Whether the audit produced at least one finding for this line item.

AuditFinding.description: A discrepancy detected during the audit between what the carrier billed and what the contract specifies.

line_item_id.description: Line item this finding is attached to.

tracking_number.description: Tracking number of the shipment the finding relates to.

type.description:
The kind of discrepancy.

- `RATE_MISMATCH`: billed rate ≠ contracted rate.
- `RATE_NOT_FOUND`: no rate in the contract matches the shipment.
- `SURCHARGE_MISMATCH`: billed surcharge ≠ contracted surcharge.
- `SURCHARGE_NOT_FOUND`: surcharge billed but not present in the contract.
- `WAIVED_SURCHARGE_BILLED`: a surcharge marked as waived in the contract was charged anyway.
- `DUPLICATE_CHARGE`: the same charge appears more than once for the same shipment.

expected_value.description: The value the contract specifies. Shape depends on `type` (e.g. `{ "rate": "10.00", "currency": "EUR" }` for `RATE_MISMATCH`).

actual_value.description: The value the carrier billed. Shape depends on `type`.

charge_type.description: Kind of charge the finding is about (denormalized from the line item).

charge_description.description: Charge description from the invoice (denormalized from the line item).

amount.description: Amount billed for the line item, as a decimal string.

service_type.description: Carrier service code (denormalized from the line item).

auditor.description: Name of the audit rule that produced this finding.

confidence.description: Confidence level reported by the auditor (e.g. `HIGH`, `MEDIUM`, `LOW`).

excluded.description: Whether this finding has been marked as known/expected by the customer and should be excluded from active findings.
